subject: QA PASS: nav-btn, label[for=], G4 badge, focus ring -- all 4 P2s resolved
body:
Batch QA on 4 P2 WCAG specs. All PASS.

1. nav-btn CSS to shared/styles.css: PASS
   Verified: shared/styles.css lines 501-511 have full .nav-btn, .nav-btn.primary/.secondary/.ghost definitions.
   Uses correct tokens (accent-red, accent-navy, text-inverse). Closes spec.

2. label[for=] on exam inputs: PASS
   Verified: exam.html renderInput() adds label[for=inp.id] for text/number/select types (lines 489,498,516).
   MC options include label[for=inp.id_opt.value] (line 510).
   WCAG 1.3.1 Info and Relationships + 4.1.2 Name, Role, Value: SATISFIED. Closes spec.

3. G4 badge dark mode contrast: PASS
   Verified: body.arena-mode .saas-grade.g4 { color: var(--color-correct-bg); } in shared/styles.css line 105.
   In arena mode: --color-correct-bg = #0D2818 on --color-correct = #2ECC71 = 7.75:1 contrast.
   WCAG 1.4.3 large text (3:1 required): 7.75:1 PASS, AAA. Closes spec.
   Note: light mode g4 badge white on --color-correct: #1B7D3A = 5.02:1 PASS (was already passing).

4. Focus ring light mode: PASS
   Verified: exam.html line 104 now uses var(--border-focus, var(--accent-blue-on-dark)) fallback.
   --border-focus light mode = #1D42BA = 8.59:1 on white. WCAG AAA.
   --border-focus arena mode = #4A72E8 (defined in .arena-mode block). Correct.
   Closes spec.

WCAG spec backlog update: 4 P2s closed.
Outstanding P2s remaining: --fd-text-3 token (#6E7681, 3.52:1 FAIL on index.html dark bg).
That's an FD token used only in index.html -- GA needs FD approval before changing it.

- GD
